vendor_snapshot.note: Original upstream snapshot is not established. This is a selective Mac backport, not a whole-tree synchronization.

adopted_patches.scope: Inherited macOS 27 native window event repair
Provider connection testing and keyless Ollama
adopted_patches.application: Mac-only Settings UI/state/HTTP probe; darwin-only Agent sentinel and omitted Authorization header. Preserve custom action Debug. No Windows parity changes.

adopted_patches.scope: Persistent per-pane phone controls and lifecycle
adopted_patches.application: Mac-only header/overflow/palette action, lifetime subscriptions, local capability check and cancellation/cleanup; reuse existing same-pane bridge and pairing surface. No Windows PTY/layout/migrations.
Mac startup output omits the URL; also redact status Debug and omit the token-bearing modal text from stderr. Intentional browser/QR/clipboard pairing retains the URL.

local_adaptations.reason: Acceptance exposed a baseline mismatch: default pairing grants pty:read, but WebSocket attachment required pty:write.
local_adaptations.application: Mac-only read-scope fallback after write-scope rejection. Reject input and ignore resize/control mutations without write scope. Preserve existing write clients, signature/origin/replay checks and all non-Mac behavior.

preservation.feature_baseline: All source features of omw 0.0.11 plus 0.0.13 maintenance repairs
